trend_aligned.instructions: `snapshot.last_close` is above all three of `snapshot.sma_20`, `snapshot.sma_50` and `snapshot.sma_200`.

breakout_claimed.instructions: Does `market_report.text` state that the price has already broken out above a prior high or resistance level?

breakout_supported.instructions: Is a breakout above a prior high supported by `snapshot`: is `snapshot.last_close` above the `snapshot.high_120d.value`?

momentum.instructions: Judging from `snapshot` (RSI, the moving averages, the recent closes), where is the price momentum over the last sessions?
criteria: Falling: recent closes lower, RSI below 45
Accelerating or stretched, RSI above 65 or price at the upper band

sharp_move_just_happened.instructions: Within the last five entries of `snapshot.recent_closes`, has the price moved more than 4 percent in a single session?

stance_warranted.instructions: Does the evidence in `snapshot` support `market_report.stance` held with `market_report.confidence`?

next_week_vs_index.instructions: Over the next five trading sessions after `as_of`, how will `ticker` most likely perform relative to the S&P 500, judging only from `snapshot` and `market_report`?

criteria.outperform: Beats the index by more than the stock's usual weekly move
criteria.in_line: Within the stock's usual weekly move of the index
criteria.underperform: Lags the index by more than the stock's usual weekly move

rating.instructions: Given `snapshot` and `market_report`, which portfolio rating for `ticker` as of `as_of`, on a one-week horizon?

criteria.Buy: Open or add a full position; strong expected outperformance
criteria.Overweight: Hold more than the neutral weight; expected to beat the index
criteria.Hold: Keep the neutral weight; no directional edge
criteria.Underweight: Hold less than the neutral weight; expected to lag the index
